Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth dates, incorrectly stating that 1893-04-15 (William C. McGann) is later than 1929-01-29 (Elio Petri). This reversed the chronology and led to the wrong conclusion; Elio Petri (1929) was born later, so the correct film is A Quiet Place in the Country.
